+"""Record preparation steps for click values."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from click.utils import make_str
+
+
+def display(value: t.Any) -> str:
+    """Convert ``value`` to a display string using ``click.utils.make_str``."""
+    return make_str(value)
+
+
+def _validate(record: t.Any) -> tuple[str, bool]:
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value entry")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    return key.strip(), enabled
+
+
+def prepare(record: dict[str, t.Any]) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return a new prepared dict.
+
+    The result has exactly ``key`` (trimmed), ``value`` (unchanged),
+    ``display`` and ``enabled``. The input is never mutated.
+    """
+    key, enabled = _validate(record)
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": display(value), "enabled": enabled}

+++ b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
@@ -35,3 +35,19 @@ def prepare(record: dict[str, t.Any]) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
     key, enabled = _validate(record)
     value = record["value"]
     return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": display(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def batch(records: list[dict[str, t.Any]]) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, t.Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared
